material_updates_additions.recall_period: Not applicable; dated company service disclosure

material_updates_additions.status: Earlier release newly reviewed. Kobo, CloudLibrary/OCLC and Libby/OverDrive describe overlapping partner services, not additive independent readership. No audiobook availability or full geographic footprint was inferred.

retrieval_limits: Three bounded official-domain searches returned catalogue pages or no results; this does not establish exhaustive release coverage.
Storytel official newsroom and press archive rendered headings and filters but omitted the dynamically loaded release list. No unchanged-release claim is based on that partial content.
Two final Storytel and BookBeat follow-up searches were not executed because the Firecrawl connected account reported exhausted credits. No quota retry was attempted.
All three referenced Kobo primary pages and the Nextory case page were retrieved live with maxAge 0 and HTTP 200 before the credit limit. No missing source was replaced with a fabricated observation.

A subsequent independent web and direct HTTP recheck of the CloudLibrary release returned inaccessible content and HTTP 403. The initial successful live primary Firecrawl retrieval (HTTP 200, scrape ID 01a2079d-e2ea-7031-ac89-517aca46da03) is retained as the extraction evidence; this later failure was not treated as withdrawal or a new observation.
